active.mapping_note: The 9-um proximal-axon candidate maps the Medlock hillock rule onto reconstructed axon segments by path distance. This is a new computational proposal, not an anatomically confirmed AIS.

identity_statement: The L292-E1-LCN reconstruction is a rat lamina-I local-circuit morphological scaffold. ePKCgamma/eVGLUT3/eDOR/eSST/eCR/eTrC labels refer to computational Medlock population identity and are not molecular identities experimentally confirmed for L292-E1-LCN.

morphology.role: generic rat lamina-I local-circuit morphology scaffold

passive_provenance: Validated on reconstructed L292-E1-LCN at 23 C; see parameters/common/passive_23C.json and reports/L292_E1_passive_23C.md

protocol.range_reason: One small hyperpolarizing step for passive measurement, zero current, and a bounded 0.05-0.40 nA excitability series spanning subthreshold through strong drive. This is an initial validation series, not an optimizer sweep.

validation_targets.medlock_transient_definition: 1-2 spikes within 100 ms of current onset
